# The control cases of tools/mali/ref_cases.py: pan_shc against Mesa's GL
# driver on drm-shim (tools/mali/README-pan_shc.md), per program region.
# A result is `equal` (the words and the facts: work_reg_count, preload, FAU
# constants, secondary_offset) or `differs:<cause>:<n>:<sha256>`: <n> differing
# instruction words and the first 12 hex digits of the digest of those words on
# both sides (pan_ref_diff.py), so another difference fails too. A `differs`
# names a front-end gap of pan_shc's SPIR-V path that the
# README explains: `mediump` (Mesa's GLSL path lowers mediump arithmetic to
# fp16, and gl_FragCoord and gl_FragColor are mediump in GLSL ES 1.00), and
# `mat-order` (a matrix times a vector is summed from the first column in the
# GLSL path and from the last in spirv_to_nir).
# name          vs                fs                    prim       region=result ...
tri             tri.vert          tri.frag              triangles  vs.position=equal fs.fragment=equal
tri_varying     tri_varying.vert  tri_varying.frag      triangles  vs.position=equal vs.varying=equal fs.fragment=equal
uniforms        ctl_uniforms.vert tri.frag              triangles  vs.position=equal fs.fragment=equal
mat4            ctl_mat4.vert     tri.frag              triangles  vs.position=differs:mat-order:18:0d8873f7ea5b fs.fragment=equal   # closes with the GLSL front end (follow-up)
psiz_points     ctl_psiz.vert     tri.frag              points     vs.position=equal fs.fragment=equal
psiz_triangles  ctl_psiz.vert     tri.frag              triangles  vs.position_no_psiz=equal fs.fragment=equal
tex_highp       ctl_uv.vert       ctl_tex_highp.frag    triangles  vs.position=equal vs.varying=equal fs.fragment=differs:mediump:17:81b3a8b98eec   # closes with the GLSL front end (follow-up)
tex_mediump     ctl_uv.vert       ctl_tex_mediump.frag  triangles  vs.position=equal vs.varying=equal fs.fragment=differs:mediump:20:ca043932e1b4   # closes with the GLSL front end (follow-up)
tex_points      ctl_uv.vert       ctl_tex_mediump.frag  points     vs.position=equal vs.varying=equal fs.fragment=differs:mediump:20:ca043932e1b4   # closes with the GLSL front end (follow-up)
